content.short: A Hybrid Layer-2 Blockchain on Cardano for Bitcoin Staking.
content.description: A revolutionary approach to joint BTC-ADA DeFi that will create a seamless application layer between Bitcoin's vast liquidity and Cardano's advanced smart contract capabilities. With over $500B+ in Bitcoin currently dormant and unable to participate in DeFi activities, our solution addresses a critical market gap while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance that institutions demand, all while onboarding new users and liquidity to Cardano.
